name: States of Matter
subject: matter

source.creator: 3D Education Engine
source.attribution: Educational model generated procedurally by 3D Education Engine, based on the standard equations of motion stated in the simulation.

educational.disclaimer: Water molecules drawn as balls, hugely enlarged and slowed down. Heat them and they move faster: they vibrate in place (ice), slide past each other (water), then fly apart (steam).

equations: average kinetic energy of the particles ∝ temperature (in kelvin)
water melts at 273 K (0 °C) and boils at 373 K (100 °C)
